name: crystoline/xpsr-audit
description: An audit log for XPSR applications: who changed what, when, and from where, with before and after values, recorded by hand or automatically for Eloquent models and Doctrine entities

suggest.crystoline/xpsr-orm-eloquent: Automatic auditing of models with the Audited trait
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-orm-doctrine: Automatic auditing of entities with the #[Audited] attribute
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-log-monolog: The request ID on each entry
